text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Tuesday it reduced the advance-purchase requirement on low fares to three days. Seats must be purchased between March 5 and 16.
A Vanguard spokesman said previous promotions have had varying advance-purchase requirements, though the normal period was 14 days.
The carrier also said that for purchases made in the March 5-16 period, senior citizens 65 years or older and children will receive a 25 percent discount on all Vanguard fares.

For purchases made on or after March 17, senior citizens and children will receive a 10 percent discount off fares. The child must be accompanied by one fare-paying adult traveling on the same itinerary.
